Vendored so bootstrap does not fetch GitHub.

- `pins.txt` is the sha256 list CI checks. `tools/check_vendor_pins.py` fails when a `vendor/*.whl` digest or its `.sha256` sidecar disagrees with that list, or when a `voxprint-common` pin in `pyproject.toml` or a `requirements*.txt` file is not the exact vendored version (a `==` pin) or, for a `>=` floor, names a version below the vendored wheel. The `pin` job calls the voxprint-common pin-check template `.github/workflows/pin-check.yml` with `tag: v0.7.4` and `lock: vendor/pins.txt`, so that list has to match the release wheel. The model-index job checks `mdl.json` against the signed index and the bundled `model-index.pin.json`. It does not run the pin check again.

- `voxprint_common-0.7.4-py3-none-any.whl`: the v0.7.4 wheel from the GitHub release v0.7.4 of Mitroshenkov87/voxprint-common (tag commit `fc97031912b52b67d3a5164c37e6e9e603d5f945`, sha256 `e5834ce279c0b3ba6dc5cae527d6270dbdcd5c233120b45a6819bd16c5e88eab`). The sidecar `voxprint_common-0.7.4-py3-none-any.whl.sha256` matches this digest. `pyproject.toml` requires `voxprint-common>=0.7.4` (main deps and the `[ui]` extra); this vendored wheel is the floor CI, the installers and the VM scripts install. It bundles the serial 11 unsigned model index (index head `15edeab0f7a874c27d2b38ef6ecb69106ff94df8`, sha256 `1137150b1646611c9b04e1fd196e9ccb53ad06025af12a3d22468be143139e5b`) without the MOSS-Image rows, so the next index Forge publishes is serial 12. The CI `pin` job checks out tag `v0.7.4` on voxprint-common. New in 0.7.4 over 0.7.3 (the shared model store, `voxprint-mdl repair-store`, `voxprint-mdl-gui`, `voxprint_common.worker`): live MDL download progress with atomic `mdl-status.json`, resumable segmented downloads, the app registry (`voxprint-mdl register --app`), `clean-partials`, and `download --gui --model` forwarding. Model Forge does not call `voxprint-mdl cleanup`, `repair-store` or `clean-partials`.
